theme_strategy: Swiss Brutalist / Archetype 4 - High-Contrast Technical Authority

rules: NO generic sans (Inter, Roboto) for headings.
Use radical weight contrast: Black for main titles, Light for body text.
Keep line lengths (ch) constrained for readability.
Headings must use tracking-tight or tracking-tighter.
Color is Function Only. 95% of UI must be monochrome.
Accents (Signal Red) used strictly for interactive states, warnings, or diagram highlights.
No full-screen gradients. Use matte, physical, technical vibes.

layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-8, p-12, or p-16 inside large containers.

grid.behavior: Visible skeleton. Expose the grid. Use 'border-collapse' style layout for data and module features. Grid items have 'border-r border-b border-white/10'.
grid.bento_mode: High Density Grid for diagrams/specs: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Every pixel utilized. h-full on children.

header.style: Solid background #0A0A0A with a hard bottom border (1px border-white/10). No pure transparency.
header.navigation: Visible desktop links. Minimal logo + Core sections (Architecture, Components, Roadmap) + Primary CTA.

surface.style: Grid Borders and Flat Solid. No glassmorphism for technical documentation to prevent refraction of precise data.
surface.radius: rounded-none or max 4px (rounded-sm) for a sharp engineering feel.

components.strategy: Shadcn components heavily customized. Strip default Vercel-look. Apply sharp corners and 1px borders.
components.buttons: Flat, sharp borders, high-contrast hover states. Eg: bg-white text-black rounded-none hover:bg-[#FF3B30] hover:text-white transition-colors duration-200.
components.cards: Flat background, 1px border-white/10, rounded-none. Hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1) and border-white/30.
components.interactive: Must explicitly set text color on hover. Use 1px inner stroke for separation.

motion.hover: Instant color swaps or subtle 0.2s ease transitions for borders/text.
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-up for markdown sections or architecture diagram blocks.
rules: Animations should feel precise and mechanical, not bouncy.

icons.style: Sharp or Regular weights. Avoid playful icons. Maintain the C++/EDA serious vibe.

images.description: Macro shot of a dark blue PCB circuit board. Perfect for the ArduLab technical landing or architecture overview header.
Blueprint architecture drafting. Great for the 'Schematic Engine' or 'Architecture Roadmap Phase' visual.
Black circuit board macro. Use for the 'Component Engine' or 'Connection Core' representation.

3d_and_creative_libraries.strategy: Since this is an Architecture Document, rely on structural UI and clean C4/Mermaid diagram renderings. Do not overuse 3D unless visualizing module graphs.
recommended: react-markdown with custom renderer for technical layouts
framer-motion for simple, mechanical transitions between document sections

accessibility.contrast: APCA preferred. Normal text > 4.5:1. Never use gray-on-gray for active UI.
accessibility.focus: High contrast ring focus: focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#FF3B30] focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-offset-[#0A0A0A].
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a web-based, standalone UI for the 'ArduLab Software Architecture Document v1.0'.
This must look like a high-end, elite engineering/developer documentation portal or architectural landing page.
Do NOT build the actual C++/Qt app. Build the web frontend to present this architecture document cleanly.
Focus on markdown rendering aesthetics, C4 diagram representations, module breakdowns, and database ER modeling UI.
Apply the 'Grid Borders' style globally to make the site feel like an engineering schematic.
Avoid typical SaaS looks. Make it rigid, technical, and precise.
Ensure the hero section sets an 'offline-first Electronic Engineering Platform' context.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) ONLY WHERE APPROPRIATE (Avoid in clinical/tech sections if it reduces clarity).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts reading flow.
Always use modern button styles like sharp or pill-shaped with interaction animations.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, custom selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on the provided image URLs. Missing categories = placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
Use sonner for toasts from /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx (if applicable in project structure).
